name: morning-brief
description: The daily synthesis surface (docs/v2/20 Lane A). Reads the deterministic morning bundle (NAV delta, overnight signal evidence, open decisions, advisor recommendations, sizing-coherence findings, execution patterns, next-48h calendar) and writes ONE judged brief row (headline + ranked attention list ≤5 + body) to morning_briefs, upserted on brief_date. SYNTHESIS ONLY — never mutates the belief layer, never raises decisions. Use when asked to "run the morning brief", "generate the brief", "what deserves my attention today", or on the 08:45 scheduled producer.
